title: QA checklist: the studio-authoring app step still tells runners to dismiss the retired currency prompt
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibxW6qraU2Z3mwupUGp

Filing gate: ① defect, named location. Out-of-scope finding of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review 6679836310 on PR #30868 (#30206, merged `18870c9289`). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.

**Business reason.** A QA runner (person or agent) following the platform checklist is told to wait for and dismiss a dialog that no longer exists. #30868 removed the console's boot-time currency / time zone dialog and put a non-modal first-run checklist on Home instead; `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` was updated in that PR, but one area step was not. A runner that waits for the prompt loses time, and one that reports its absence files a false finding.

## Where (`origin/main` `18870c9289`)

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json:3687`, inside `steps[1]`:

> open the app (a fresh organization first shows the 'Set the default currency' prompt over the page; dismiss it with 'Not now', RUNNER environment facts)

## Wanted

Drop the parenthetical (the checklist on Home is not modal and does not cover the app), or replace it with a pointer to RUNNER.md's current wording. One step, docs-only; no other area file names the prompt (one hit for `Not now` or `default currency' prompt` under `docs/qa/` at filing).

**Level:** docs only, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Dedupe: `"Set the default currency" prompt` (9 hits: QA run reports and closed cards, none about this step); `"Not now" studio-authoring` (121 hits, QA run reports). **New.**

Related: #30206, PR #30868.
